title: Reflection from a mismatched load on a 50 Ω line
caption: The reflection coefficient Γ = (Z_L − Z₀)/(Z_L + Z₀) is zero for a matched load (Z_L = 50 Ω) and the power reflected is Γ². For the 75 Ω antenna Γ = (75 − 50)/125 = 0.2, so Γ² = 0.04: 4% of the power is reflected.
alt: Graph of |Γ| and Γ² against load impedance from 10 to 150 ohms: both reach zero at 50 ohms; at 75 ohms |Γ| is 0.2 and the reflected power fraction is 0.04.
description: The horizontal axis is the load impedance Z_L in ohms for a line of Z₀ = 50 Ω; the vertical axis is the size of the reflection coefficient |Γ| and the fraction of power reflected, Γ².
Both curves touch zero at Z_L = 50 Ω: a matched load reflects nothing.
At Z_L = 75 Ω, |Γ| = 25/125 = 0.2 and the reflected power is Γ² = 0.04, 4%.
The power curve lies below |Γ| because Γ² is smaller than |Γ| when |Γ| < 1.
